questions.stem: If the transmission voltage is increased by a factor of 4, by what factor are the power losses in the cables reduced?
questions.explanation: If the voltage increases by a factor of 4, the current decreases by a factor of 4 (since P = IV). Power loss = I squared R, so losses decrease by 4 squared = 16 times. This is why even small increases in transmission voltage have large effects on efficiency.
